Floodplain_bypass_link.description: Floodplain flow around a structure (above the bank of the upstream compound segment)

fp_depth.description: Water depth above the bank of the upstream segment

area.description: Floodplain flow area (outside the main-channel column)

Floodplain_bypass_link.helptext: Manning flow over the floodplain part of the upstream Compound Channel Segment only: depth above bank_depth, outside the main-channel width (area = floodplain_width*d + floodplain_side_slope*d^2, d = head - bottom_elevation - bank_depth). Place it in parallel with an in-channel structure such as 'Leaky Dam with pipes', whose weir spans only the channel: above bankfull, water goes around the structure across the floodplain. Uses the upstream (source) segment's section, so connect it in the downstream direction.
